items.title: Meta spend 2026-10-19 to 10-25: $352.31, 16 leads, CPL $22.02
items.summary: 7-day window spend was $352.31 CAD across 7,972 impressions and 226 clicks, yielding 16 leads at about $22.02 CPL. Only active campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, accounted for all spend (running near its $50/day budget).

needs_attention: Window widened to 7 days (2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25): no prior meta-ads.json found in the last 7 days. Totals cover the whole window, not just yesterday.
No separate baseline pull or CPL anomaly comparison made; the 7-day pull was the window itself. No anomalies or alerts detected (account ACTIVE, no flagged ads).
